text: Aster's volume, and so any volume-based liquidity ranking of its listings, has been disputed. Aster's CEO confirmed an internal investigation and denied any market-maker arrangement; the trader theory of a perp-market distortion spilling into spot prices remains unconfirmed. text: Hyperliquid's HIP-3 requires a deployer to hold 500k HYPE staked (maintained for a minimum of 183 days after the dex is deployed) to deploy one perp dex with independent margining and order books. The first 3 assets deployed in any perp dex need no auction participation; additional assets go through a Dutch auction. A deployer can settle an asset with the `haltTrading` action at the current mark price and reuse it, and once all assets are settled the required stake is free to be unstaked. Validators can slash a deployer's stake for malicious market operation. (high confidence) (verified as of 2026-11-22)
